[]( [...] Five weeks after the end of the last international window,during which they played three matches,including two qualifiers for the 2027 PAMOJA AFCON,the Indomitable Lions return to action on November 9 in Douala. This marks the start of a double-header against Namibia, scheduled for November 12 and 16, 2026, which will serve as the third and fourth matchdays of the qualifying campaign for the tournament,a competition set to take place in June and July 2027 across Uganda, Kenya, and Tanzania.
